purpose: Teach: タップ/ブロードウェイ/弱み/できあがり/打ち明け/年末年始/放り/おしえ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、スマホのタップ早いな
lines.en: Riku, you're crazy fast at tapping on your phone.
lines.style: Light, surprised observation with a hint of admiration. Quick delivery. Eyebrow raise in the voice. Testing whether he'll take the compliment or deflect.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ブロードウェイ、いつか行きたいよな、桜
lines.en: You want to go to Broadway someday, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft, almost tentative. A question that feels like he's testing the water, revealing something he's been thinking about. Brief pause before her name, like he's deciding whether to say it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の弱み、隠したって意味ないぜ
lines.en: Riku, you can hide it all you want — doesn't matter, does it?
lines.style: Knowing smirk in the voice. Steady, unrushed. A callout wrapped in affection. She's not angry, just... seeing him. Let the ending land softly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお弁当、できあがりが芸術的だな、桜
lines.en: Your bento comes out looking like art, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, no performance. A real compliment, simply stated. Slightly slower pace on the last part. He means it and isn't waiting for her to argue with him about it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、本音、ぼくに打ち明けてくれよ
lines.en: Riku, just... tell me the real stuff, okay?
lines.style: Soft but direct. No edge. A request that's also a reassurance. Slight breathiness on 'real stuff.' She's asking him to trust her without making a big deal of it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、年末年始、塾あるんだろ?桜
lines.en: You have cram school over the year-end break, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Casual check-in. Light, not probing. He's connecting dots quietly. Small smile in the tone. The question masks that he's been thinking about her schedule.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、教科書放りっぱなしだぜ
lines.en: Riku, you left your textbook just lying there.
lines.style: Teasing lilt. Slightly exasperated but not unkind. She's pointing out what he already knows. Quick pace. The kind of thing a friend says when they're close enough to call you out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英語おしえてくれよ、桜
lines.en: Teach me some English, will you, Sakura?
lines.style: Direct, a little uncertain. Not quite a question, not quite a demand. Quiet sincerity underneath. He's asking for her help and her time, which matters to him.
